keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Little Falls Township, homeowners pay an average of $11,749.92 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.92% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 62.24%, assessed values average ~62.24% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 53.6% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 29.8%, and Passaic County claims 16.6%.
